Great experience
Jan 2018 • Family
Baby spoon is a unique restaurant in Ho Chi Minh specialising in Italian and Japanese cuisine. 

The food is amazing. I would recommend the Japanese baked scallops with cheddar cheese, the sushi and the creme brulee. My family primarily ordered appetisers to share for variety and found that they filled us up. 

We have been here for dinner two nights in a row now and have experienced friendly service, affordable prices and great food both times.

Horrible experience. Avoid like the plague.
Oct 2017 • Couples
Went here a couple of nights ago with my girlfriend. I had the duck pasta and ended up with severe food poisoning, rendering me bedridden for the best part of 2 days. My girlfriend had the potato bolognese and nearly choked on a piece of metal mixed into the sauce.

Whilst we ultimately weren't charged for the potato bolognese, we were over charged for the duck pasta and garlic bread. Whilst we tried to work it out, the waiter stood there looking over our shoulder bluntly stating the bill was right. The error was only about 4,000 VND, but we couldn't be bothered arguing and just wanted to leave as soon as possible.

I would not wish this place on my worst enemy. You have been warned.

A big disappointment with servings!
Mar 2017 • Couples
We've eaten at this restaurant on many occasions as a frequent visitor to Saigon. The food was always slow being served however worth the wait.
We returned soon after arrival in Saigon this current visit to be disappointed in both the size of serving and the service.
Staff have informed me after our meal and when I complained that 'we have a new menu'. From my observation, the menu has been reprinted, the previous offer of small and large serving has been removed; leaving the previous higher price as the "new" but small serving.
Baby Spoon is perhaps under new ownership, we will never get to meet them as we're not returning!

Baby Spoon!!!! Our fav HCMC nosh place!
Dec 2016 • Couples
Stumbled across this fantastic little restaurant. The pizza's were our choice for the second night in a row for dinner, also had lunch here yesterday! We can highly recommend it, the food, customer service ( all the staff ) great booths and air conditioned!!!! 

Upstairs bar has Happy Hour 5-9 50% off cocktails but not keen on cigarette smoke in a seperate closed in area. 

If you love Gorgonzola try the Gorgonzola Pizza! Nasi Goreng and Spring Rolls were amazing. Oh, and try the sweet corn soup!!!

This is a real find!
